title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From silent library carrels to sunlit cafe booths, these ten study environments across the Vestal campus and downtown offer the best focus for every academic style.

cards.title: East Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Glenn G. Bartle Library, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Find a seat in this designated quiet zone for deep focus. It is located on the first floor of the main library and is ideal for students who require absolute silence.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet study space on the first floor of the Glenn G. Bartle Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The East Reading Room on the 1st floor of Bartle Library is a designated quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms and Study Spaces | Libraries - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; no reservation required for open seating.

cards.title: Bartle Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Glenn G. Bartle Library, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Utilize the newly remodeled open study space featuring modern seating and large windows. It offers a variety of chairs and couches for a more relaxed academic atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A newly remodeled open study area with diverse seating options and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: The newly remodeled third floor of Bartle Library features a variety of seating options perfect for group or individual study.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms and Study Spaces | Libraries - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Open study space; no reservation required for general seating.

cards.title: Science Library Ground Floor
cards.subtitle: Science Library, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Retreat to the ground floor for a very quiet environment. This floor is known for being less busy than Bartle and houses the extensive map collection.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, focused study environment located on the ground floor of the Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Science Library has a very quiet ground floor and houses research materials in various scientific fields.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; individual study carrels are available on all floors.

cards.title: University Undergrounds Lounge
cards.subtitle: University Union, Basement
cards.notes: Study in a social atmosphere with background noise. This basement lounge is perfect for group projects or solo work near the Food Co-Op and bowling alley.
cards.short_summary: A social study lounge in the University Union basement with a mix of solo and group seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Undergrounds Lounge is located in the basement of the University Union and is a great place for group projects or solo study.
cards.source_title: 11 of the Best Study Spaces in Binghamton
cards.access_notes: Open late; Monday-Thursday until midnight and Friday-Saturday until 1am.

cards.title: John Arthur Café
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Enjoy floor-to-ceiling windows and a bright atmosphere. This cafe space is a favorite for students who prefer studying with natural light and a coffee nearby.
cards.short_summary: A bright, sunlit study spot located within the Fine Arts Building.
cards.evidence_claim: John Arthur Café features floor-to-ceiling windows that allow for a bright and motivating atmosphere for work.
cards.source_title: 11 of the Best Study Spaces in Binghamton

cards.title: Innovation Lab
cards.subtitle: University Union
cards.notes: Work in a modern space with ample outlets hanging from the ceiling. The large windows provide excellent natural lighting for daytime study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A modern, centrally located study space in the University Union with high-tech amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Innovation Lab in the Union has large windows for natural lighting and plenty of outlets hanging from the ceiling.
cards.source_title: My 10 Favorite Study Spots at Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Centrally located; can get noisy during peak hours.

cards.title: UDC Library
cards.subtitle: University Downtown Center, Main Floor
cards.notes: Scan your BU ID to access this quiet downtown resource. It offers individual study carrels and reservable rooms for students working off the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library and information commons located at the University Downtown Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The UDC Library-Information Commons is located on the main floor of the University Downtown Center and offers quiet study rooms.
cards.source_title: UDC Library - Information Commons - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Requires BU ID for entry; open Monday-Thursday 7:30am-10pm.

cards.title: CIW Library
cards.subtitle: College-in-the-Woods
cards.notes: Visit this lesser-known residential library for a cozy vibe. It features isolated desks and study rooms with whiteboards, perfect for focused tutoring or solo work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, residential library in College-in-the-Woods with diverse study options.
cards.evidence_claim: The CIW Library has a variety of study space options including isolated desks and study rooms with whiteboards.
cards.source_title: 11 of the Best Study Spaces in Binghamton

cards.title: Appalachian Collegiate Center
cards.subtitle: Mountainview College
cards.notes: Study with a view of the campus and hills. This center offers couches and tables with large windows, providing a quieter environment than other dining hubs.
cards.short_summary: A scenic study spot in Mountainview College with large windows and a quiet atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Appalachian Collegiate Center in Mountainview has couches, tables, and big windows with views of campus.
cards.source_title: My 10 Favorite Study Spots at Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Open late for food and study; features a Success Center for extra resources.

cards.title: South Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Glenn G. Bartle Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Take your books to the outdoor patio during warmer months. This second-floor lounge allows for eating while studying and offers a mix of individual and group seating.
cards.short_summary: A versatile study lounge in Bartle Library featuring an outdoor patio and group seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The South Study Lounge on the 2nd floor of Bartle Library includes an outdoor patio and allows for eating while studying.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms and Study Spaces | Libraries - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor patio access is weather-dependent; lounge is open during library hours.
